title: procurement solicitations - u.s. embassy in cyprus
paragraphs: welcome to the procurement section of the general services office on this page you will be able to find information about solicitations issued by the embassy of the united states of america in nicosia for the acquisition of commodities and/or services. please direct all questions regarding solicitations to the procurement section via email nicosiacontracting@state.gov . solicitations request for quotation – new vehicle – minibus 8 seaters 19cy6026q0028 – request for quotation request for quotation – structured cabling st the west office building 19cy6026q0022 – structured cabling at the west office building request for quotation – chief of mission residence fence extension 19cy6026q0024 – chief of mission residence fence extension see also: system for award management (sam) start guide for international registrations entity checklist
